d:
Feel the heartfelt emotions of love and longing in “Dil Tere Naam Se Dhadakta Hai”, a soulful romantic duet from Aadmi. With powerful performances by Mithun Chakraborty and Gautami, and melodious vocals by Kumar Sanu and Kavita Krishnamurthy, this song remains a cherished gem of the '90s.
Dil tere nam se | Dil Tere Naam Se | Mithun Chakraborty, Gautami | Aadmi(1993) | Kumar Sanu Hit Song
Movie: Aadmi (1993)
Song: Dil Tere Naam Se
Star Cast: Mithun Chakraborty, Gautami
Singer: Kumar Sanu, Kavita Krishnamurthy
Music Director: Jatin Lalit
Lyricist: Rani Malik
